CHR subjects with comorbid cannabis use have a blunted DA response to stress compared to CHR subjects who do not use cannabis.
cannabis use in CHR individuals is associated with reduced stress-induced dopaminergic reactivities.
the dopaminergic response to stress is reduced in individuals who use cannabis, but is enhanced in those with concurrent psychosis.

the dopaminergic stress reactivity may be a marker of vulnerability to schizophrenia and cannabis use.
the interaction between cannabis use and stress may be complex and not necessarily additive.
